name: vintage-travel-ticket
title_zh: 把一张照片变成一张有年代感的中国老门票
tagline_zh: 手头有旅行、街景、美食旧照？不用翻资料，直接生成一张以假乱真的复古门票。设计语法提炼自 66 张历史票根。
tagline_en: Turn any travel, street, or food photo into a convincing vintage Chinese ticket—design grammar distilled from 66.
desc_en: Turn a user-supplied travel, landscape, city-street, personal-memory, object, transport, or food photo into one finished vintage Chinese ticket using a detailed design grammar distilled from 66 historical ticket references without distributing the private images. Use when the user asks for an old ticket, vintage admission ticket, retro travel coupon, scenic-area ticket, food tasting ticket, or wan
why_zh: 不是滤镜叠加，而是从 66 张真实票根里提炼版式、字体、印章、褪色规律，按你的照片内容自动套用。
why_en: Not a filter—it rebuilds layout, type, seals, and fading from 66 real tickets, then adapts to your photo's content. Output looks.
limit_zh: 只做单张票证，不做套票或系列；输入需是清晰照片（模糊或低分辨率会直接失败）；不保证票面文字可读性。
limit_en: Single ticket only, no sets. Needs a clear photo—blurry or low-res fails. Text on ticket may be illegible; add exact dates/numbers yourself.
